body:
We need to make full implementation of PEG/regular expression like grammar language that is able to produce parsers for languages like http://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation, any programming languages, natural languages and so on.

It should also should be easy to use it as substitution patterns as in http://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli, but not only for links, for any text in general.

So any patterns with complex variables, conditions, should be possible to define and use to make turing complete substitutions like in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markov_algorithm, but much more powerful.

So these transformation rules can be used to for example produce formal based language translations: 
- https://github.com/linksplatform/RegularExpressions.Transformer
- https://github.com/linksplatform/RegularExpressions.Transformer.CSharpToCpp

We also need to make sure our engine is implemented both in Rust and JavaScript, and is dialect fully parsable by http://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation and compatibe with query/substituions in http://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli.

But it should be possible to operate these substitution rules on regular unicode texts like PEG/regular expressions.

It should be down in Rust, JavaScript as library, CLI, microservice, and GitHub Pages web app (that should support both engines JavaScript and Rust + WebAssembly, that should be executed at the same time in web workers, so they don't block the UI).

We also need to support grammar inference by examples. So we can feed some examples on what substitutes to what, and make automatic grammar inference, meaning output should be deduced substitution rules. I heard it is possible, search in the internet for the best practices that are available and use it in our software.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Use all the best practices from CI/CD templates (check full file tree to compare for all GitHub workflow and CI/CD scripts file), if the same issue is found in template report issue also in templates:
- https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template
- https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template

We should compare all files, so we don't have more CI/CD errors in the future and reuse all the best practices from these templates.

Please plan and execute everything in a single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Initial version of software
